title: Zesty American Blackberry Parfait
description: A bright, tangy parfait that layers fresh blackberries, chilled yogurt, and a molten dark chocolate drizzle, perfect for a quick hangover cure.
instructions: Place the Greek yogurt in a bowl, add stevia, honey, lemon juice, orange zest, vanilla extract, and a pinch of sea salt, then whisk until smooth.
Fold in the fresh blackberries gently to keep them intact.
Pour the mixture into two serving glasses and chill in an ice bath of water with ice cubes for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the dark chocolate chips over a double boiler or in a microwave, heating 20-second intervals until smooth, keeping the temperature below 80°C.
Remove the parfaits from the ice bath and pat dry the glasses.
Drizzle the molten chocolate over the top of each parfait, allowing it to set slightly.
Garnish with crushed, lightly toasted almonds on top of the chocolate drizzle.
Serve immediately, ensuring the parfait remains chilled.
Enjoy the bright, tangy flavor that helps soothe a hangover and satisfies a sweet craving without excess sugar.
